newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian Helicopter to sell Juan shares.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian Helicopter to sell Juan shares.

text.p: Malaysian Helicopter Services Bhd said on Thursday it was proposing to sell a 17.5 percent stake in electrical supplies maker Juan Kuang (Malaysia) Industrial Bhd for 42.67 million ringgit.
Malaysian Helicopter said the price of 10 ringgit per share of Juan Kuang was arrived at on a "willing seller, willing buyer basis".
Malaysian Helicopter announced this in a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
The company said it was selling the stake to paper bag maker KYM Holdings Bhd, who would satisfy the purchase with cash.

The sale would enable the company "to focus its activities in line with its core business," and would not have any material effects on the company's earnings for the financial year ending December 31, 1997, Malaysian Helicopter said.
Malaysian Helicopter owns a 32 percent stake in national carrier Malaysian Airline System Bhd.
